verdict.rationale: Salesmate is a hosted SaaS CRM, and open-source licensing is a fair axis for CRM products. Nothing in the evidence shows its source code is published under an open license. The only related item is 'publicly available RESTful APIs', which is API access, not source availability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
